landing_hero_title: Your pass to the German citizenship test
landing_hero_subtitle: Practice all 300 official questions plus the 10 for your state, take realistic mock exams and watch your readiness grow. Free, without ads, without an account.
landing_hero_continue_hint: Your progress is saved on this device. Pick up where you left off.
landing_demo_caption: Example: your pass shows readiness, known questions, streak and today's goal.
landing_how_subtitle: Three steps from your first question to a calm exam day.
landing_features_subtitle: Built around the real exam: 33 questions, 60 minutes, 17 right answers to pass.
landing_feature_modes_desc: New questions, quick rounds, review of your mistakes or one topic at a time.
landing_feature_mock_title: Mock exam like the real one
landing_feature_mock_desc: 33 random questions, a 60-minute timer and a clear result at the end.
landing_feature_streak_desc: A few questions every day keep the streak alive and the knowledge fresh.
landing_feature_progress_desc: Readiness, weak topics and your mock exam history at a glance.
landing_feature_translations_desc: Read each question in English, Turkish, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Ukrainian and more.
landing_feature_dark_desc: Easy on the eyes late at night. Follows your system or your choice.
landing_feature_offline_desc: Questions and progress live on your device, so you can learn on the train or underground.
landing_feature_private_desc: No account, no tracking, no data sent anywhere. Open source.

landing_download_web_desc: Nothing to install. Works in any modern browser on phone, tablet or desktop.

landing_reviews_subtitle: Voices from people who prepared with the app.
landing_faq_subtitle: Short answers about the test, the platform and your result.

landing_explore_general_desc: Read every question with its correct answer, free and without an account.
centers_desc: Where you can take the Einbürgerungstest or the Leben in Deutschland test in {state}.
centers_intro_1: The test is only taken at centres approved by the BAMF, usually adult education centres (Volkshochschulen) or language schools. Register directly with a centre; it sets the date and collects the fee of 25 euros.
centers_intro_2: Bring your ID or passport on exam day. You have 60 minutes for 33 questions, and your result comes by post from the BAMF.
centers_empty_desc: Try a nearby city or just the postcode.
centers_note_body: The list comes from the BAMF and can be out of date. Call or write to the centre to confirm dates, address and how to register.
privacy_desc: How lebenindeutschland.org and the Einbürgerungstest app handle your data: no accounts, no tracking, nothing leaves your device.
privacy_english_only: The legally binding text of this notice is available in English only.
